ev.q: 61.5% of children aged 9--13 years do not participate in any organized physical activity during their nonschool hours
Fewer children aged 9--13 years reported involvement in organized sports (38.5%) than in free-time physical activity (77.4%)
61.5% of children aged 9--13 years do not participate in any organized physical activity during their nonschool hours
Non-Hispanic black and Hispanic children were significantly less likely (p<0.05) than non-Hispanic white children to report involvement in organized activities
a nationally representative survey of children aged 9--13 years and their parents

methods_quotes.q: T-tests were conducted when appropriate by using a Bonferoni adjustment to identify statistically significant differences among subpopulations.
Data were adjusted for parent and child nonresponses and standardized to decennial census estimates of children's race/ethnicity, age, and sex.
WesVarPC software was used to calculate point estimates and 95% confidence intervals
